text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":15,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"buys 15 oranges"},{"id":"q2","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"2 sons"},{"id":"q3","value":8,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"oldest son is 8 years old"},{"id":"q4","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"half as old"}],"plan":[{"op":"div","args":["q3","q4"],"out":"s1","note":"divide oldest son's age (8) by 2 to find the youngest son's age (half as old)"},{"op":"add","args":["q3","s1"],"out":"s2","note":"add oldest and youngest sons' washing counts (equal to their ages) together"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"subtract total oranges washed from the 15 total to find how many remain unwashed"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"oranges left unwashed"},"dismissed":[{"value":2,"reason":"states Will has 2 sons; already reflected by adding the oldest's and youngest's individual washing amounts, not a separate multiplier"}]}
